in_arabic.name: إرامة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الإرامة تعني الإكثار من الإجلال والترجيع والإكبار، وقد أطلقها الله تعالى على قوم إبراهيم في قوله تعالى: {وَجَعَلنٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ تَبْشيرًا وَأَنبِيَاءَ عَلٰى الْقَرارِ وَبَشّارًا بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْ عِندِنَا وَتَحميدٍ تَبَشيرًا} [الفاتحة: 4 - 7]

in_urdu.name: اِرماح
in_urdu.meaning: مرجئہ اور ترجیع، احترام اور کبھار
in_urdu.long_meaning: اِرماح کا مطلب ہے احترام اور ترجیع میں برتری رکھنا، جس کا ذکر قرآن مجید میں بھی ملتا ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ نے ابراہیم علیہ السلام کے قوم کے بارے میں کہا ہے: {وَجَعَلنٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَا إِلَيْهِمُ تَبْشيرًا وَأَنبِيَاءَ عَلٰى الْقَرارِ وَبَشّارًا بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْ عِندِنَا وَتَحميدٍ تَبَشيرًا} [الفاتحة: 4 - 7]

in_hindi.name: इरामाह
in_hindi.meaning: मर्जेयत और तर्जीयत, पूजा और भक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: इरामाह का अर्थ है मर्जेयत और तर्जीयत में भी श्रेष्ठता रखना, जिसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जहां अल्लाह ने इब्राहीम अलैहिस्सलाम के बारे में कहा है: {वज्जलनाहुम आम्मत याह्डोन बि अम्रना वावहय्ना इलैहिमु तब्शिरन वानबिआअ अला अलकरार वब्शारन बिरहमति मिन अजदिना वतहमिदिन तब्शिरन} [फातिहा: 4 - 7]

in_english.name: Iramah
in_english.meaning: High esteem, reverence, worship, and glorification of Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Iramah refers to the high esteem, reverence, worship, and glorification of Allah. This concept is deeply rooted in Islamic tradition. In the Quran, it is mentioned that Allah referred to the nation of Ibrahim as 'A'immah' (leaders) who guide people according to Allah's will and are given knowledge and wisdom (Fatiha: 4-7). In Islamic culture, Iramah is considered a virtue that involves showing extreme respect, reverence, and adoration for Allah.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Iramah" in Arabic language is said to evoke images of a peaceful and serene environment, invoking feelings of calmness and peacefulness. It is often associated with places of beauty, solitude, and tranquility. This name would have significant cultural impact when used to name a place, a community, or a project, as it sets the tone for a prosperous and harmonious atmosphere. This name can be a powerful symbol of hope for communities seeking to escape the chaos and turmoil of the outside world and create a safe and peaceful space for themselves.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name "Iramah" holds great spiritual significance. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said that the last part of his life was spent in a place called Iramah, a paradise-like garden where he found peace and tranquility amidst the tumult of the world. Iramah is therefore seen as a symbol of the sense of peace and calmness that comes from drawing closer to Allah, and a reminder of the importance of seeking His pleasure above all else. For many Muslims, the name evokes a deep longing for the peace and beauty of the Garden of Paradise, and a yearning to live a life worthy of entering it.
